title: Preserve last valid wizard step index when showNextStep throws
acceptanceCriteria: showNextStep on the last step still throws IllegalStateException with the Invalid index. message
After the exception, currentStep equals the last valid index and never equals steps.size or a larger value
Repeated showNextStep calls after the first failure each throw and leave currentStep unchanged at the last valid index
Successful navigation still advances exactly one step per call and emits a navigatorLiveData event only for the reached step
The focused regression test in WizardManagerTest fails before the fix (RED) and passes after the fix
nonGoals: No change to onBackPressed boundary behavior below index zero
No change to setCurrentStepIndex, stepPosition, isLastStep, or any public API signature
No change to the exception message or to success-path LiveData event timing
No changes to SiteCreationMainVM, RestoreViewModel, BackupDownloadViewModel, or any other caller
No device or instrumentation tests; no dependency, Gradle, or build-file changes; no documentation changes
testPolicyReason: A behavior regression requires a focused unit test proving the retained step index after the exception
